bagPolicy.summary: Yankee Stadium has implemented a clear bag policy to enhance fan safety and expedite entry. Only specific types and sizes of bags are permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Yankee Stadium parking is in several garages and lots around the Bronx ballpark operated by third parties, with prepaid rates (via SpotHero/Ticketmaster) cheaper than drive-up. Many fans use transit: the 4, B and D trains stop at 161st St-Yankee Stadium and Metro-North serves the Yankees-E 153rd St station. Lots open a couple hours before first pitch.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Yankee Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Yankee Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including classic comfort foods with bold flavors and modern twists. Highlights include specialty items like Bacon Wrapped Hot Dogs, Pastrami Fries, and indulgent treats like Soft Serve and Milkshakes. The venue features a lively Beer Garden and several concession stands with unique offerings.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Yankee Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry will be permitted only in the case of an emergency.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Yankee Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Yankee Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
